target.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveHookNameFromDir` in `src/hooks/install.ts` reads `HOOK.md` with an unbounded `fs.promises.readFile` call. A malicious or malformed hook package containing a multi-gigabyte `HOOK.md` could force the install path to buffer the entire file into memory just to extract the hook name from frontmatter, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

`HOOK.md` is only parsed for a short frontmatter block (name, description). A 1 MiB cap is generous headroom for legitimate hook documentation while preventing the install path from being used as a memory exhaustion vector.

## User Impact

Installing a hook package with an oversized `HOOK.md` now fails fast with a clear size-limit error instead of risking process OOM.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test that writes a `1 MiB + 1` byte `HOOK.md` and asserts `installHooksFromPath` rejects with `File exceeds 1048576 bytes`.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/hooks/install.test.ts --run` passes (29/29 tests).


## Real behavior proof

I wrote a standalone Node script (`/tmp/proof-101469.mjs`) that imports the real `installHooksFromPath` from `src/hooks/install.ts`, creates two bare hook directories under `/tmp`, and exercises the code path directly. The script uses `inspection: "package-kind"` to avoid install-policy and target-availability side effects while still going through `resolveHookNameFromDir`, where the bounded `HOOK.md` read lives.

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/proof-101469.mjs
== PR 101469 real behavior proof ==
workDir: /tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461
HOOK.md size limit: 1048576 bytes

-- Normal case: small HOOK.md --
hookDir: /tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461/normal-hook
result: {
  "ok": true,
  "hookPackId": "normal-hook",
  "hooks": [
    "normal-hook"
  ],
  "packageKind": "hook-only",
  "targetDir": "/tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461/hooks/normal-hook"
}

-- Oversized case: HOOK.md = 1 MiB + 1 byte --
hookDir: /tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461/oversized-hook
HOOK.md bytes: 1048577
error: File exceeds 1048576 bytes: /tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461/oversized-hook/HOOK.md
PASS: oversized HOOK.md rejected before downstream processing

-- Cleanup --
removed /tmp/openclaw-proof-101469-1783419986824-2374461
```

The normal hook directory is accepted and its frontmatter name is returned. The `1 MiB + 1` byte `HOOK.md` is rejected with `File exceeds 1048576 bytes` before any frontmatter parsing, policy scan, or install copy runs, confirming the bounded read is enforced on the real code path.
